club.name: Claude Builder Club at NJIT
club.description: A student community for learning about AI and building projects with Claude, supported through Anthropic's Claude Campus Ambassador program.
club.membership: Open to NJIT students of any major and experience level. No coding experience is required.
club.mission: Help students learn practical AI skills, build their own projects, and understand the benefits and risks of using AI.
club.activities: Hands-on learning, student projects, and peer collaboration. Specific workshops and meeting times are announced separately; no recurring schedule is confirmed here.

apiCredits.description: The 2026-2027 program describes $25 in Claude API credits for club members, subject to the program's eligibility and processing requirements.
apiCredits.uses: Credits may be used for personal projects as well as club projects.
apiCredits.eligibility: Use a school email address for the developer account, complete the member sign-up process, and complete the meeting check-in form when attending meetings. Joining after the first meeting does not by itself exclude a member.
apiCredits.organizationId: Use the organization ID from platform.claude.com, under Settings > Organization. An organization ID from the Claude chat app is not the same thing.
apiCredits.requestProcess: Ask the e-board for the current member sign-up and credit-request steps. This site cannot submit a request or check an account's credit status.
apiCredits.availability: Signing up does not immediately or automatically grant credits. No delivery date is confirmed here.

claudePro.description: Club members can get Claude Pro by attending meetings and completing the meeting check-in form.
claudePro.eligibility: Attend club meetings and complete the meeting check-in form. Joining the club does not by itself grant Claude Pro.
claudePro.separateFromApiCredits: Claude Pro and the $25 Claude API credits are separate benefits. API credits are for programmatic use in projects and do not activate a Pro subscription.
claudePro.requestProcess: Follow the check-in instructions given at the meeting, or ask the e-board for the current steps. This site cannot check eligibility or Pro status.
claudePro.availability: Completing check-in is not confirmed to activate Pro immediately or automatically. No activation date is confirmed here.
claudePro.unconfirmed: How long the benefit lasts, how many meetings or how often members must attend, when access is activated, and renewal rules are not confirmed.
